data_sources.name: epa_tri_basic
data_sources.label: EPA TRI Basic data
data_sources.description: Annual facility-reported chemical release/transfer inventory under TRI reporting scope and thresholds. Release mass is not environmental concentration, exposure or toxicity-weighted risk. Dioxin-category mass is grams; other chemicals are pounds. Grams-TEQ is a separate quantity requiring congener/TEF information. Historical submissions may be revised; pin retrieved file checksums. EPA public data; credit EPA TRI and reporting year.

products.name: tri_basic_2020_verified_chemicals
products.label: TRI Basic 2020: native-verified chemical/mass fields
products.description: Native 2020 North Carolina CSV verifies chemical identities, exact column headers and unit strata. Bindings cover only the chemicals observed in that sample and six separately documented release fields; they are not a complete national chemical register or every Basic column. The national download route accepts US, state and tbl scopes; this profile points to the inspected NC delivery. Preserve TRIFD/FRS, document control, chemical/CAS/category ID, Form type, YEAR, unit, datum and industry. Off-site totals are attributed to reporting facilities, not the off-site destination geometry. Totals overlap their component fields and must not be added together. Non-reporting and Form A blank amounts are not automatically zero. HORIZONTAL DATUM is blank in all sample rows: do not assert a uniform EPSG:4326. Generic CSV is not csv_station_observations, so native_format is unset. process_tri uses 0.453592 kg/lb (slightly truncated), may group facilities by shared coordinates, and regex-selects columns; these are adapter limitations. calculate_tri creates a distance-decay indicator, not an atmospheric dispersion or exposure model. The catalog exact unit_conversion_formula is declarative and is not executed by process_tri. Its grouped outputs are not lossless facility/document records; sums with na.rm=TRUE and pivot filling can turn missing amounts into zeros. Use the existing tri_read_raw helper for source-record review, preserving native identity and missingness; a blank native datum remains unresolved.
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: Reporting facilities in the inspected North Carolina 2020 file; no continuous coverage
products.native_spatial_resolution_descriptor: Facility-reported point, with row-level horizontal datum
